technical_gate.note: The isolated import and prefab foundation are technically intact, but the Root Unity-scale visual gate fails. The package-owned domain-reload token deletion error is recorded as baseline external noise and is not attributed to this builder.

visual_findings: Muzzle is dominated by large hard white triangular wedges and thin needle-like streaks. The black and neutral-gray renderer proofs confirm these are the visible authored forms rather than a background artifact; they read as clipped cards or primitive spikes, not a polished twin-energy launch.

The imported body preserves the two-star count, but at Unity hero scale it reads as two thick brown flower/cog plates attached to bulky black polygonal pucks. The stepped carrier is visually heavy, the load path is obscure and the surface response is below the user's commercial close-up floor.

The warm brown star faces have broad flat areas and weak metal hierarchy, while the surrounding dark masses crush together. Neutral-gray proof loses additional silhouette separation instead of proving a clean manufactured assembly.
Flight contains small pure-white triangular attached forms with obvious hard edges between the bodies. They do not become a coherent attached trail or controlled twin-core energy flow.
Impact is a low-detail radial fan of long golden needles. It is sparse, small and primitive, and violates the no-needle/no-generic-radial-star direction for a commercial contact event.
R1 is technically organized but visually far below the user's supplied minimum reference and therefore cannot proceed to lifecycle testing.

body_r8_contract.source_rule: Freeze all R7 authored and transport artifacts. Create a separate R8 authored Blender revision; do not overwrite or copy back into the approved/frozen source paths.
body_r8_contract.identity: Keep exactly two unequal five-lobed impact anvils and one connected asymmetric twin carrier, but redesign the visible Unity-scale assembly so it reads as a premium twin penetrator rather than flower plates on polygonal pucks.
body_r8_contract.star_profiles: Refine each anvil into a thick manufactured penetrator with tapered lobe roots, controlled broad bevels, a recessed face tier and a deeply captured non-circular key. Remove cookie/flower softness and flat brown plate dominance.
body_r8_contract.carrier: Replace the bulky near-circular dark back masses with a directional tapered yoke/carrier, a lower center valley and two visibly changing-section load webs that seat each anvil across multiple faces. The silhouette must show forward cutoff, unequal end mass and a compressed rear receiver.
body_r8_contract.materials: Use commercial lit satin gunmetal, restrained brushed warm brass/bronze and pale tempered key faces. Remove wood-like brown streaking, crushed black values and white clipping. Bevel highlights must remain visible under Unity reconstruction.
body_r8_contract.evidence: Follow Blender Agent Studio authored refinement and validation with original-resolution material/clay hero/opposite/six orthographics, star-seat/load-web/rear-receiver macros, gameplay and exact128 evidence. Stop for Root body review before new FBX/GLB/Unity transport.

vfx_r2_contract.dependency: Do not rebuild or attach final Flight until the R8 body and new three-branch transport pass Root. Offline Muzzle/Impact exploration may proceed without Assets writes.
vfx_r2_contract.muzzle: Replace hard triangular wedges and needles with two unequal converging tapered transparent energy lobes, one compact warm core and a soft shared pressure shoulder. No visible card boundary, pure-white clipping, spike fan or detached line set.
vfx_r2_contract.flight: Use two body-contact tapered wake lobes that originate behind the unequal anvils and merge into one restrained warm-gold tail, plus at most two tiny sparks. No white triangles, needles, equal beads, star mesh or detached ribbon.
vfx_r2_contract.impact: Use two offset short rounded gold contact lobes around one displaced hot core and one low-alpha asymmetric fold. Preserve a twin event without a radial star, spokes, long needles, ring or screen-filling cloud.
vfx_r2_contract.proof_gate: Before any 30-cycle run, provide original 1024x768 M/F/I timing, body-only and body+Flight hero/gameplay, black and neutral-gray single-renderer proofs for every distinct role, and the unchanged benchmark comparison.
